race.comment: SQUAD (3) led and just failed to hold on under 60kgs over this course and distance two back then failed on a heavy track in town before a seven-week let-up. Smart sprinter when fresh and this is his pet trip. Classy enough to take care of these. OVER YONDER (1) showed pace when resuming over this trip at Morphettville last time out but his condition gave out late in the piece. Finds an easier race today and should offer a lot more resistance. TRULY ELSA (8) found the line with purpose and was only beaten two lengths when resuming over 1000m at Murray Bridge four weeks ago. Placed in a subsequent jump-out. Open to plenty of improvement with the blinkers back on today. Senior citizen THE MAGISTRATE (10) was runner-up as favourite here at this trip last time. Good each-way hope again. MUSICAL SUNSET (13) is a lightly raced mare back from a 19-week spell. Consistent performer who should be ready to run well.
